channel.title: Brain Sprint: Read-Along Maths for Kids
channel.description:
Quick mental maths for kids, about two minutes per episode. A friendly voice asks ten questions, pauses so your child can answer out loud, then gives the answer. Great for the car, breakfast or the walk to school. Episodes go from adding within ten up to times tables.

Made by Honest Little Apps, the makers of Brainy Bucks: Math & Reading, a kids' learning app with a free daily quest, no ads and no accounts. Brainy Bucks: Math & Reading on the App Store

Narrated with a synthetic (text-to-speech) voice.
